assessment_objectives.objective: serious incidents and/or irregularities associated with the deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are reported to the AAT provider within an organization-defined period.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 72 hours after the serious incident or irregularity is identified

assessment_objectives.objective: serious incidents and/or irregularities associated with the deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are reported to the AAT importer or distributor within an organization-defined period, where the AAT was obtained through an importer or distributor.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 72 hours after the serious incident or irregularity is identified

assessment_objectives.objective: serious incidents and/or irregularities associated with the deployment of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) are reported to local law enforcement authorities and/or governmental agencies within the period required by applicable statutory or regulatory requirements.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no later than the shortest applicable statutory or regulatory reporting deadline
